import numpy as np, collections, pprint, math
G=np.full((20,20),3,int)
# divider column
G[:,11]=9
# rectangular frame
G[4,3:12]=9
G[10,3:12]=9
G[4:11,3]=9
# c11 already divider
G[9,4]=2
G[18,1]=4
G[18,18]=7
G[19,0]=7
G[19,19]=6
# label components non-9
H,W=G.shape
seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(H):
 for c in range(W):
  if G[r,c]==9 or (r,c) in seen: continue
  q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
  for p in q:
   cells.append(p)
   for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
    nr,nc=p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc
    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and G[nr,nc]!=9 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
     seen.add((nr,nc));q.append((nr,nc))
  comps.append(cells)
for i,cells in enumerate(comps):
 rs=[r for r,c in cells];cs=[c for r,c in cells]
 rr=(min(rs),max(rs));cc=(min(cs),max(cs))
 spe=[(r,c,int(G[r,c])) for r,c in cells if G[r,c]!=3]
 print(i, len(cells), rr,cc, spe)

out=G.copy()
for i,cells in enumerate(comps):
 rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
 r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
 vals={int(G[r,c]) for r,c in cells if G[r,c]!=3}
 # choose corner minimizing sum of Chebyshev grid distance to special cells? inspect seed placements
 specials=[(r,c,int(G[r,c])) for r,c in cells if G[r,c]!=3]
 corners={'tl':(r0,c0),'tr':(r0,c1),'bl':(r1,c0),'br':(r1,c1)}
 # pick corner with lowest summed Manhattan distance, usually unique
 name,corner=min(corners.items(), key=lambda kv:sum(abs(r-kv[1][0])+abs(c-kv[1][1]) for r,c,v in specials))
 dr=1 if corner[0]==r0 else -1
 dc=1 if corner[1]==c0 else -1
 # seeds along inward diagonal from corner, including colored cells only (known layouts)
 seq=[]
 # identify the contiguous diagonal colors from corner until first background after at least seed; here 3 is bg
 rr,cc=corner
 while r0<=rr<=r1 and c0<=cc<=c1:
  v=int(G[rr,cc])
  if v==9: break
  if v!=3: seq.append(v)
  elif seq: break
  rr+=dr; cc+=dc
 if not seq: seq=[3]
 for r,c in cells:
  d=min(r-r0,r1-r,c-c0,c1-c)
  out[r,c]=seq[d%len(seq)]
 print(i,name,corner,seq)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))

from collections import deque

def fill_comps_wave(A,B,wall,bg):
 h,w=A.shape; comps=components(A,wall); P=A.copy(); meta=[]
 for i,cells in enumerate(comps):
  cellset=set(cells)
  specs=[(r,c,int(A[r,c])) for r,c in cells if A[r,c] not in (bg,wall)]
  if not specs: continue
  rs=[r for r,c in cells];cs=[c for r,c in cells];r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs);c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
  corners={'tl':(r0,c0),'tr':(r0,c1),'bl':(r1,c0),'br':(r1,c1)}
  name,corner=min(corners.items(), key=lambda kv:sum(abs(r-kv[1][0])+abs(c-kv[1][1]) for r,c,v in specs))
  dr=1 if name.startswith('t') else -1; dc=1 if name.endswith('l') else -1
  seq=[]; seen_marker=False;rr,cc=corner
  while r0<=rr<=r1 and c0<=cc<=c1:
   v=int(A[rr,cc])
   if v==bg:
    if seen_marker: break
    seq.append(v)
   elif v==wall:break
   else: seq.append(v);seen_marker=True
   rr+=dr;cc+=dc
  if not seen_marker: continue
  # wave distance to boundary cells
  dist={};q=deque()
  for r,c in cells:
   isbd=(r==0 or c==0 or r==h-1 or c==w-1)
   if not isbd:
    isbd=any((r+dr0,c+dc0) not in cellset for dr0,dc0 in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))
   if isbd: dist[(r,c)]=0;q.append((r,c))
  while q:
   r,c=q.popleft()
   for dr0,dc0 in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
    p=(r+dr0,c+dc0)
    if p in cellset and p not in dist: dist[p]=dist[(r,c)]+1;q.append(p)
  for r,c in cells:P[r,c]=seq[dist[(r,c)]%len(seq)]
  meta.append((i,corner,seq,max(dist.values())))
 return P,meta
P3,meta3=fill_comps_wave(A,B,7,2)
